stage: Bounded development follow-up of the same repeatedly inspected A-E data. Not an independent confirmatory test. No raw recapture and no thesis/Overleaf modification in this step.
inputs: Hash-verify frozen noncoherent_uniform_20261106 results and selected caches from coherent_array_validation_20261106. Reuse exact packet ledgers; never reselect packets for a better direction.
budget: Each arm/run has 864 distinct packets. Six-state arm: 24 cycles x 6 states x 6 packets; G2: 24 chronological batches x 36 packets. R1 first8=288 packets fit reference and weights; last16 held empty. R2 first12=432 predict, last12 check. R3 is never used to fit the new primary. Same per-run budgets do not mean equal simultaneity or equal packets per antenna.
hypotheses: B: rank-one background projection may leave secondary background covariance that controls the foreground eigenvector; subtract the projected R1 covariance before eigendecomposition.
C: conflicting per-state and per-band structures and C2 spatial aliasing can undermine fusion; separate per-state normalization from R1 reliability weighting, and retain all alternate branches.

Two-sided covariance change may be better represented by signed rank-adaptive MUSIC than a positive-only mode; compare balanced and weighted versions of this already declared kernel without choosing by site.
primary: SIX_PCD_R1: projected covariance-difference MUSIC with R1-only positive reliability weights and state-balanced costs. Our experimental adaptation, not an established claimed published algorithm.
PCD: B=I-hh^H from the leading R1 eigenvector. D=B(R_target-R_ref)B. Positive eigenvalues must exceed the maximum spectral norm of B(R1_block-R_ref)B over the two disjoint four-cycle R1 training blocks. Exactly one significant positive mode is required per tone; rank0 and rank2 tones fail. Cost a^H(B-uu^H)a/(a^HBa), actual tone and antenna coordinates. Require raw R1 leading fraction>=0.70 and at least half tones valid in each band. Angular projected energy >=10% is checked consistently in all states.
fusion: POOL uses sum numerators / sum denominators. BAL uses equal mean of state normalized costs. R1 uses the existing frozen positive R1 reliability weights. All new arms require every state to have adequate tones and candidate-angle projected energy; no silent partial array. Thus POOL/BAL/R1 differ only in cost aggregation and weights, not eligibility. Existing baselines keep their original eligibility and are separately labeled.
baselines: Retain all ten prior declared methods unchanged; primary comparisons are G2_BG, matched-kernel G2_PCD and prior SIX_WBG_R1. No per-point substitution; no winner promoted after truth scoring.
selection: Full forward grid -90:1:+90 deg, global minimum, three separated local minima including legitimate endpoint minima, separation>=15deg. Use existing peak routine unchanged. Truth coordinates are absent from new prediction code; only score after prediction hashes are written.
checks: Reuse existing time<=9deg, each low/high half-band<=9deg, >=3/4 quarters within9deg, nonedge |angle|<87deg, alternative margin>=3dB, power>R1held, power>R3 and no matching R3 full/low/high direction. Power remains unpreconditioned background-projected energy of unit-energy packets, explicitly not detector likelihood. R3 pre-return candidate count is an internal false-candidate diagnostic. Missing numerical outputs are retained, all-five mean becomes NA; report coverage and conditional quantities separately.
gain: For primary vs both G2_BG and G2_PCD: all five numerical; mean lower; median and max not worse; at least four sites improved; accepted-candidate coverage positive and not worse; empty false-candidate count not higher. Physical release remains false irrespective of internal metrics. Relative improvement vs prior fusion reported separately.
audit: Report B/C covariance drift, within/between empty contrasts, eigenvalue ranks, projection retention versus angle, shared/aliased array manifold and per-state spectra. Geometry is used for steering and scoring, never to select peaks. B,C diagnoses do not justify changing their individual settings.
stop: One fixed six-arm follow-up, all A-E, then freeze and score once. No post-score parameter sweep. Retain failures. If instability/calibration ambiguity persists, document the remaining cause and minimal independent data rather than manufacturing gain.
